data.name: 残存之物 Remnants
data.detailed_description: This is a survival crafting game. You play as a survivor in the aftermath of an AI uprising, stranded on a 4 km × 4 km island. You will need to chop wood, mine resources, build shelter, craft powerful weapons, and use everything around you to survive in a harsh and dangerous environment.
data.about_the_game: This is a survival crafting game. You play as a survivor in the aftermath of an AI uprising, stranded on a 4 km × 4 km island. You will need to chop wood, mine resources, build shelter, craft powerful weapons, and use everything around you to survive in a harsh and dangerous environment.
data.short_description: A survival crafting game set after an AI uprising. Stranded on a 4km × 4km island, you must gather resources, build shelter, and craft weapons to survive. Currently in early development, with core systems evolving and new content planned.

content_descriptors.notes:
Violence:
The game contains realistic combat involving firearms and melee weapons against hostile creatures or enemies.
Violence is presented in a grounded and realistic manner, but it does not include excessive gore, dismemberment, or prolonged highly graphic depictions of injury.

Nudity / Sexual Content:
The game may feature partial male nudity on character models, consistent with common survival or sandbox-style games.
There are no sexual acts, sexual interactions, or erotic content depicted.

Drugs, Alcohol, and Medical Items:
The game includes food, medical, and survival-related items.
Some items simulate the use of medicine or substances strictly for gameplay mechanics, such as health or status recovery.
Drug misuse, substance abuse, or addiction is not depicted, promoted, or encouraged.

Sensitive Topics:
The game does not include sexual violence, non-consensual sexual acts, BDSM, self-harm, or depictions of extreme or excessively graphic violence.
